verdict.rationale: Browserbase is an API-driven browser platform, so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question. The evidence pack documents the SDK, webhooks, CLI and MCP server, but nothing mentions API versions, version pinning, or a deprecation or sunset policy. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
